Maya: Heads-up — onboarding volans13b (v1.2 quant int4) hit a mem surge on dev canary. Hotstart p95 spiked and several pods OOMed.
Dmitri: ugh. symptoms?
Maya: p95 latency went from 120ms -> 450ms, GPU mem usage jumps after first few requests. logs show repeated page faults and KV shrink loops.
Leo: can you paste the mini log?
Maya: ```
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] serve[volans13b]: alloc failed: cudamalloc 105MB -> retry
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] runtime: evicting KV slots (reason=slot_pressure, freed=3)
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] runtime: batch_started batch_size=8 max_new_tokens=256
```
Sara: interesting — batch_size 8 + max_new_tokens 256 on int4 might blow the temporary kernel workspace. volans has a wider attention head layout causing alignment padding.
Aj: did we try microbatching? default batch window + continuous batching may create big aggregate workspace.
Maya: yes — toggled microbatching to 2 and reduced batch_window to 12ms, no OOMs in smoke but throughput drops 18%.
Dmitri: what about changing default max_new_tokens for volans to 128? Run eval: quality vs perf.
Maya: ran offline eval on our eval set (6k prompts): int4 vs fp16 perplexity diff +0.8% but longer responses (>120 tokens) show token quality drift; hallucination rate up 1.6%.
Leo: acceptable trade for most customer workloads, but we need safe defaults. proposal: volans int4 canary config = {"batch_size_limit":4, "microbatch":2, "max_new_tokens_default":128, "kv_compactor":"aggressive"}
Sara: +1, add rollout guard: CPU fallback to fp16 if slot_compactor triggers >5 evictions in 60s.
Aj: add routing policy: heavy latency-sensitive customers routed to fp16 dedicated until canary stable.
Maya: I'll create canary with 5% traffic, baseline A/B for 48h. Metrics to track: p50/p95 latency, OOM count, evictions, perplexity, hallucination rate. I'll paste the perf commands.
Maya: ```sh
# deploy canary
rictl deploy --model volans13b --variant int4-canary --traffic 0.05 \
  --config microbatch=2,max_new_tokens=128,batch_limit=4,slot_compactor=aggressive
```
Dmitri: also drop streaming chunk size to 32 tokens to reduce KV peak.
Leo: add alert if p95 > 300ms or OOM > 0 in 1h.
kv-bot: Alert rule created: channel=eng-ml, condition=oom_count>0 window=1h, notify=@oncall
Sara: quick benchmark numbers from local GA-run (single A100): fp16 throughput=420 t/s, int4 before tweaks=510 t/s but tail latency bad; int4 after microbatch & max_new_tokens=128 throughput=395 t/s.
Aj: so we lose a bit of throughput but gain stability — sounds reasonable.
Maya: scheduled canary deploy at 03:30 UTC. I'll update the rollout doc and add evaluation notebook link: https://redwood.internal/s/volans13b-int4-eval
Dmitri: cool. after 48h, if stable, we can relax batch limits gradually and test slot_compactor:lax fallback.
Leo: one more thing, add a regression test in CI that runs a small 100-prompt gen with max_new_tokens=200 to catch mem regressions.
Maya: done. CI job name: volans-int4-smoke. Anything else?
Sara: remind infra to monitor kernel workspace allocs — put metric in Grafana dashboard.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
